notes.Business DSCR description: EBITDA divided by annual debt service: existing interest, annual CPLTD and the proposed loan's annual payments.
notes.Global DSCR description: Owner-weighted business EBITDA plus guarantors' wages and interest or dividend income, divided by business debt service plus guarantors' mortgage, auto and card payments.
notes.FCCR description: EBITDA divided by annual debt service plus annual operating leases.
